# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, **please do not open a public issue**.

Instead, report it privately by emailing the maintainer or using [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/aliansyahFirdaus/windoc/security/advisories/new).

Please include:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact

You'll receive a response within 72 hours. Once confirmed, a fix will be prioritized and a security advisory published.
